title: form.submit raises ValueError when loading a spreadsheet
body:
Environment

Lattice version 3.1.6; operating system Fedora 41
Workstation; server region ap-south-1.

Steps

Steps to reprodcue:
- Open Lattice and begin loading a spredsheet.
- Enter an amount with eight decimal places.
- Check the log window; the traceback appears there.

Expected

No traceback; loading a spreadsheet normally takes a few
seconds.

Actual

A long decimal is what trips it. Anything with over six
decimal digits fails, fewer digits work.

Frequency

Reproduces twice this week.
stacktrace:
lattice/ui/main.py:48 in loop
lattice/ui/dialog.py:92 in on_import
lattice/io/batch.py:54 in run_import
lattice/ui/form.py:257 in submit
ValueError: invalid date '2026-03-29 02:30'
